name: shagunshopping
description: ShagunShopping — MERN e-commerce store for a multi-brand cosmetic shop (India). React + Vite storefront, Express/MongoDB API, Razorpay payments.

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend-shagunshopping && npm install --prefix shagunshopping-frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend-shagunshopping" "npm run dev --prefix shagunshopping-frontend"
